question: Is GCL spatial specificity absence due to floor effect or power issue?

verification_1_floor_effect.method: vf_mean tertile stratification, GCA 6x6 diagonal vs off-diagonal
verification_1_floor_effect.rationale: Floor effect would predict delta(severe) < delta(mild). Observed: delta(severe)=+0.091 > delta(mild)=+0.042. Severe patients retain more GCL spatial structure, not less. Moderate (n=93) shows flattest pattern — likely sampling noise at this VF range.
verification_1_floor_effect.finding: Severity-dependent specificity: severe patients show stronger GCL sector specificity (delta=+0.091, 3/6 rows) than mild patients (delta=+0.042, 3/6 rows). This is the opposite of floor effect.

verification_2_power.method: GCA sector 95% CI width vs RNFL quadrant CI width
verification_2_power.verdict: ADEQUATE POWER — but signal inherently small
verification_2_power.rationale: GCA CI width (mean 0.202) is only 19% wider than RNFL q_i (0.170), not dramatically different. RNFL detected hemifield difference of rho=0.376 with similar n. GCL sector differences are ~0.02 in rho — even with n=1000 this signal would be near-undetectable. Signal is fundamentally small, not a power issue.

overall_conclusion.verdict: GCL sectoral specificity absence is biological, not artifactual
mechanisms: GCL/IPL broadly distributed across macular sectors with overlapping RGC dendritic fields
Garway-Heath boundaries do not map cleanly to GCL anatomical topology
Global GCL avg (beta=0.480) outperforms any single sector (max beta=0.441)
overall_conclusion.nuance: Severity modulates GCL specificity: severe disease shows Δρ=+0.091 (stronger sector structure than mild Δρ=+0.042). This may reflect that focal advanced loss creates detectable sector-VF correspondence, while mild diffuse loss spreads signal across sectors.
overall_conclusion.paper_statement: GCL sectoral specificity was absent in the full cohort (Δρ=+0.020, 2/6 diagonal rows maximal). Stratified analysis excluded floor effect (severe Δρ=+0.091 > mild Δρ=+0.042) and insufficient power (comparable CI widths to RNFL). GCL average thickness is the most efficient GCL predictor of VF sensitivity.

revision_2026_07_05.trigger: 재분석: 분산 보정 적용 후 경증 Δ -0.017→+0.030으로 이동. 경증 GCL ρ=0.104 확인(range restriction)
revision_2026_07_05.retracted_claim: 경증 Δ=+0.042 → 중증 Δ=+0.091의 '중증도 의존적 GCL 섹터 특이성' 강한 결론 철회

replacement_conclusion.severity_dependent_verdict: WEAK/UNCERTAIN — 분산 보정 후 중증도 의존성 간극 절반으로 축소
replacement_conclusion.mild_stratum: 경증 Δ 원래값(+0.042)은 VF ceiling(CV=3.9%) + GCL range restriction 아티팩트가 대부분. 분산 보정 후 Δ≈+0.030으로 이동. 해석 주의.
replacement_conclusion.severe_stratum: 중증 Δ=+0.091은 충분한 VF 분산 내에서 산출됨 — 유효
replacement_conclusion.revised_statement: GCL 섹터 특이성 중증도 의존성은 불확실. 경증에서의 낮은 특이성은 주로 range restriction 아티팩트. 중증에서 Δ=+0.091은 해부학적 특이성의 약한 신호를 시사하나, 전체 Δ=+0.020(매우 작음)은 GCL 구조적 비특이성의 주된 결론으로 유지.
replacement_conclusion.floor_effect_verdict_unchanged: Floor effect 배제 결론(REJECTED)은 유지 — 분산 보정 후에도 severe > mild
